title: Extract query column-scan fast paths
problem: Column-scan aggregate, DISTINCT, and GROUP BY fast paths occupied over 1000 lines in query/mod.rs.
approach: Move column-scan fast path types and Executor helper methods into the new submodule.
Keep shared query helpers such as order_limit_column_name and column_arg_index in query/mod.rs.
risk_controls: Do not change fast path semantics.
Run cargo check --lib plus column_scan, distinct, and group_by SQL integration filters.
